candidate.definition_en: To take over the place, position, or role of someone or something, or to force someone or something from their usual place.
candidate.explanation_ar: يزيح حاجة أو حد من مكانه ويحل محله، أو يهجر ناس من بيوتهم غصب عنهم.

senses.definition_en: To take over the place, position, or role of someone or something.
senses.definition_ar: يحل محل شخص أو شيء أو يزيحه عن موقعه.
examples: New automated systems may soon displace human workers in routine factory jobs.

senses.definition_en: To force people to leave their home, region, or country.
senses.definition_ar: يُهجّر أو يُشرّد أشخاصاً من ديارهم قسراً.
examples: Severe seasonal floods threaten to displace thousands of families from the valley.

senses.definition_en: To move something out of its normal physical position.
senses.definition_ar: يزيح شيئاً من موضعه الطبيعي (كالماء أو الأجسام).
examples: A solid object submerged in a container will displace its own volume of liquid.
New automated systems may soon displace human workers in routine factory jobs.
Severe seasonal floods threaten to displace thousands of families from the valley.
A solid object submerged in a container will displace its own volume of liquid.
candidate.mnemonic: 'Dis' 'نفي/إزالة' + 'Place' 'مكان'.. يعني تشيل حد من الـ 'Place' بتاعه.
